mapper.select: select EFF_DATE effDate,INT_RATE yield from MST_INT_RATE_INFO where INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT T1.MDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 WHERE (T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} OR T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId})

SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_TYPE, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.ISSUE_AMT, T2.BASIS FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T3 on T3.FINPROD_ID=T1.FINPROD_ID AND T3.CASH_TYPE_2=#{cashType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T2.EFF_DATE = T1.VDATE where T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select to_char(CDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as HOLIDATE from VAL_VW_MST_HOLIDAY where IS_HOLIDAY > 0
and CDATE >= to_date(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and CDATE <= to_date(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and TRADE_CALENDAR_ID = #{dealCalId}
